Load hoopR NBA Stats Synergy play-type stats

Source: R/load_nba_stats_extra.R
load_nba_stats_synergy.Rd

Loads the nba_stats_synergy release: 72 files per season, one per season type, play type, offensive/defensive split and per mode ({season_type}_{play_type}_{type_grouping}_{per_mode}_{END year}.parquet). The requested combinations (all of them by default) are bound into one frame, one row per player per play type per split. season_type and per_mode are added from the file name when a file's rows lack them. Reading both per modes widens the counting columns (poss, pts, fgm, fga, fgmx), which are integer in totals files and decimal in pergame files, to double.

Usage

load_nba_stats_synergy(
  seasons = most_recent_nba_stats_season(),
  season_type = NULL,
  per_mode = NULL,
  type_grouping = NULL,
  play_type = NULL,
  ...,
  dbConnection = NULL,
  tablename = NULL
)

Source

The nba_stats_synergy release: https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases/tag/nba_stats_synergy, published by https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data.

Arguments

seasons

A vector of 4-digit years – the season's START year (e.g. 2024 for the 2024-25 season), like every load_nba_stats_*() loader. Published coverage starts at 2015 (2015-16). Pass seasons = TRUE for every published season.

season_type

"regular-season" and/or "playoffs"; NULL (the default) reads both.

per_mode

"pergame" and/or "totals"; NULL reads both.

type_grouping

"offensive" and/or "defensive"; NULL reads both.

play_type

One or more of cut, handoff, isolation, misc, offrebound, offscreen, postup, prballhandler, prrollman, spotup, transition; NULL reads every play type of each requested type grouping. cut, misc, offrebound and transition are published for the offensive split only.

...

Additional arguments passed to an underlying function that writes the season data into a database.

dbConnection

A DBIConnection object, as returned by DBI::dbConnect()

tablename

The name of the data table within the database

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per player per play type per split.

col_nametypesdescription
season_idcharacterstats.nba.com season code: a season-type digit (2 = regular season, 4 = playoffs) followed by the season's START year, e.g. '22024' = the 2024-25 regular season.
player_idintegerstats.nba.com player identifier (PERSON_ID); joins to every other nba_stats loader.
player_namecharacterPlayer's full name as stats.nba.com lists it (e.g. 'Nikola Jokic').
team_idintegerstats.nba.com team identifier.
team_abbreviationcharacterTeam tricode (e.g. 'BOS').
team_namecharacterTeam nickname (e.g. 'Celtics').
play_typecharacterSynergy play type as stats.nba.com labels it, e.g. 'Isolation', 'PRBallHandler', 'Spotup', 'Transition'.
type_groupingcharacter'Offensive' (the player's own possessions of this play type) or 'Defensive' (opponent possessions of this play type the player defended).
percentilenumericPercentile rank (0-1) of the row's points per possession among players with this play type.
gpintegerGames played in the split.
poss_pctnumericFrequency: share (0-1) of the player's possessions that were this play type.
pppnumericPoints per possession on this play type.
fg_pctnumericField-goal percentage (0-1) on this play type.
ft_poss_pctnumericShare (0-1) of this play type's possessions that produced free throws.
tov_poss_pctnumericShare (0-1) of this play type's possessions that ended in a turnover.
sf_poss_pctnumericShare (0-1) of this play type's possessions that drew a shooting foul.
plusone_poss_pctnumericShare (0-1) of this play type's possessions that ended in an and-one.
score_poss_pctnumericShare (0-1) of this play type's possessions that scored at least one point.
efg_pctnumericEffective field-goal percentage (0-1), weighting made threes by 1.5.
possintegerPossessions of this play type (integer in 'totals' files, double per game).
ptsintegerPoints scored on this play type.
fgmintegerField goals made on this play type.
fgaintegerField goals attempted on this play type.
fgmxintegerField goals missed on this play type.
seasonintegerEND year of the NBA season (2025 = 2024-25) – the published asset's own stamp, one more than the seasons argument.
season_typecharacterSeason type of the source file: 'regular-season' or 'playoffs' (the release file-name token).
per_modecharacterAggregation of the source file: 'pergame' (per-game averages) or 'totals' (season totals); stamped from the file name when the rows lack it.

See also

The publishing pipeline, https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data, and the Python twin sportsdataverse.nba.load_nba_stats_synergy().

Other NBA Stats loader functions: load_nba_stats_coaches(), load_nba_stats_draft_combine, load_nba_stats_game_matchups(), load_nba_stats_hustle, load_nba_stats_injury_report(), load_nba_stats_leaguedash(), load_nba_stats_matchups(), load_nba_stats_metric_curves(), load_nba_stats_rolling_windows()
